training.code: train/build_data.py, train/train_qlora.py (not shipped in the submission zip; handover by repository version)
training.method: QLoRA (4-bit NF4 base) with TRL SFTTrainer and PEFT
training.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6 GB, WSL2 Ubuntu 22.04, torch 2.11.0+cu128, Python 3.12
training.labels: organizer-estimated TRL from the public USGS sheet; not expert gold

data_sources.source: APCTT public sample cases and the USGS PDFs they reference (contracts/public-cases.json, USGS reports)
data_sources.role: Development, prompt and rule tuning, and public-case evaluation of the assessment module
data_sources.label_origin: Organizer's estimated TRL per report; not expert labels and not the hidden-case labels
data_sources.linked_project: None; the 99 public reports are listed individually in contracts/public-cases.json
data_sources.license: U.S. public domain (USGS); some figures are third-party, see the manifest's licence_note

data_sources.source: USGS reports used to fine-tune the optional TRL adapter (74 of the public cases, split by SDG target)
data_sources.role: Supervised fine-tuning of the QLoRA adapter; validation on a held-out SDG 14 split and on a stratified random split
data_sources.label_origin: Organizer's estimated TRL from the public sheet, used as the target label; not expert gold
data_sources.license: U.S. public domain (USGS); some figures are third-party, see the manifest's licence_note

inference_assets.source_code: participant_module/ (adapter.py, extract.py, rules.py, llm.py; package hash in submission.json)
prompts_or_rules: participant_module/rules.py (criterion rules matched by checklist description, not by ID)
dependency_declarations: the common base environment apctt-base-9e7fe1324bb6 (pypdfium2, torch, transformers, peft, bitsandbytes)
catalogue model smollm3-3b-nf4 (only loaded when settings.use_llm is true)

notes: The shipped default is CPU rules-only (settings.use_llm=false): pypdfium2 text extraction, sentence filtering, description-matched criteria rules with page-and-span evidence. The adapter is bundled and declared but disabled because it did not beat the rules-only TRL prior on the held-out SDG 14 public split (0.68 vs 0.70 mean part-A score). No NASA TechPort data was used.
